component.name: Liquid Deck
component.summary: Stream Deck and live hardware dashboard

description.p: Liquid Deck serves a local web dashboard with live CPU/GPU metrics, a media player, OBS controls and a configurable macro deck. It is a single native binary with the UI embedded, so it needs no runtime besides a browser.
It listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default and can be exposed to the LAN with --lan plus a --token. The phone client and the web UI talk to the same process.
